sentences: This response reports 2 aggregations across 2 groups from 96 of 100 records.
Aggregation 1 `total` runs AGG_SUM on `revenue`. Total of a numeric field, over all rows or per group. It read 90 rows and left out 4 with no value.
Aggregation 2 `avg_score` runs AGG_AVERAGE on `score`. Average of a numeric field, over all rows or per group. It read 88 rows and left out 6 with no value.
The run read 100 records; 96 passed the filters and 0 were left out for a missing value.
